name: Sugimura Hiroko
source:
A nurse working at Jomiya General Hospital. Reports directly to Sakaguchi. She is a caring, attentive, and excellent nurse. She is very popular in the hospital.

She and Manami are best friends. When Sakaguchi finds out that she has been stealing sleeping pills from the hospital, she is blackmailed.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1327]Getchu[/url]]
